en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European town taken from across a river. In the foreground is a wide, shallow river with a stony bank. On the opposite bank stands a row of elegant late‑19th‑century townhouses and villas with ornate facades and steep roofs, set behind a riverside promenade lined with trees. Behind the houses the terrain rises steeply into a densely forested hillside, with a few villas and terraced vineyards higher up the slope. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
